The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center creating a stepped silhouette. Below the pipes is a wooden gallery structure with decorative paneling and doors. In the foreground, there is a low metal railing separating the viewer from the instrument. Light projects patterns onto the upper stone arches.
